preregistration.checkpoint: Two separate exact A/D replays per mapping/seed; independent 2s neutral rest; no parent calibration
preregistration.design: Fixed 2x2; all four conditions carried unchanged from pilot to fresh confirmation
preregistration.factorial: Descriptive seed-paired combination-minus-reference/singles and interaction Y11-Y10-Y01+Y00, separately per mapping and primary endpoint; raw paired accuracy and learning advantages over each control
preregistration.fixed: effect_2ch/32, deterministic encoding, three copies at weight0.9, Core tau20ms, action/effect50ms; homeostasis/development off
preregistration.hypothesis: Combined recurrent propagation and longer timing sensitivity may enable learned action-effect prediction
preregistration.limits: Extra spikes, weight alignment, or descriptive interaction alone are not learning; smoke/pilot cannot confirm; no parameter tuning or condition selection

multiplicity.rule: Every required one-sided exact paired sign test must pass; ties omitted; Bonferroni over four conditions x two endpoints

preregistration.no_copy: Independent neutral-frame replay without action copies at both primary checkpoints
preregistration.rate_gain: Same baseline reference gain per seed; no renormalization per condition
preregistration.recurrence: Scale all initial Core->Core weights, excitatory and inhibitory, by 1 or 4; endpoints and delays fixed
preregistration.stdp: Existing nearest-pair rule: both plus/minus tau20 or100ms, a_plus0.0001/a_minus0.00012, pair window100ms, weights0..2
preregistration.success: At least ten seeds; visual >=80% in each mapping; count prediction above chance and all controls in both mappings; flip/dual-correct above all controls; all lower paired bootstrap95 bounds positive
preregistration.weights: Initial and trained visual weight sums and retained fraction, per seed/arm; monitor possible LTD cost
